deviations.departs: The four-site retrospective cohort is not redistributed
deviations.paper_location: Sec. III-F, DATA AND CODE AVAILABILITY
deviations.why: It is held at its contributing institutions under a data-use agreement. The release ships the record contract and a schema-compatible cohort fixture that holds every reported marginal exactly, so the mechanisms are executable without the records.

deviations.departs: The per-type split of the 386,204 entities and the 7,431,905 relations is a declared default, as is the 1,024-entity mechanistic core
deviations.why: The manuscript states the two census totals and the two type counts but not the allocation between them. Without a declared annotation core, a record's anchors would have no admissible route to any treatment and the path mechanism could not run at all.

deviations.departs: Four of the sixteen comparator rows are reported as NOT_RUN
deviations.why: The chain-of-thought, retrieval-augmented, multi-step knowledge-graph and architecture-search comparators are defined by a hosted instruction model, which this release neither bundles nor calls. The twelve statistical comparators are implemented.

deviations.departs: Optimiser, learning rate, schedule, batch size, epoch count, grad clip and the composite objective are engineering defaults
deviations.why: The manuscript reports the training budget in GPU-hours and no optimiser settings. Each default is exposed in configs/train/default.yaml and configs/experiment/main.yaml so a reader can see and change it.

deviations.departs: The monotone transform is fitted by isotonic regression
deviations.why: The manuscript specifies a monotone transform of S_theta fitted on the training split without naming the family. Isotonic regression is the minimal monotone fit and is checked against a second solver.

deviations.departs: The abstention-reason profile is not reproduced
deviations.paper_location: Sec. IV-A to IV-G (no reported abstention ground truth)
deviations.why: Sec. IV-C reports abstention concentrated in three subgroups, but the cohort carries no field marking why a record abstained, so the profile is NOT_RUN rather than inferred.

paper: Multimodal Knowledge Graph and Agentic AI Framework for Interpretable Melanoma Treatment Response Prediction
scope_note: Each entry maps a stated artefact of the article to the code that carries it. PASS means the mapping was checked by execution or by an independent recomputation on this tree; NOT_RUN means the artefact is a cohort-level measurement this release does not reproduce; BLOCKED means the check needs an artefact that is not redistributed.
